records.text: Michael Jackson's estate and the Beatles catalog were stolen from him by the people he was fighting.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: his estate was basically stolen from him ... by the very people that he was fighting. ... he died and had his entire estate and the Beatles catalog that he owned taken from him.

verification.notes: Sony and the Michael Jackson Estate jointly announced a negotiated 2016 sale of the Estate remaining 50 percent interest in Sony ATV for 750 million dollars. The Estate received substantial consideration and retained other Jackson publishing rights. That primary transaction record directly contradicts the assertion that the estate and Beatles catalog were stolen after his death.

sources.title: Sony and Jackson Estate Announce Closing of Sony Purchase of Remaining Sony ATV Interest
sources.relevance: Primary joint announcement documents a paid, negotiated purchase from the Estate rather than a theft.
